description: RESERVED NSID — unimplemented. Per RFC 014, the canonical mining-sourced card is tools.spec.srs.card.created with the optional miningSource field. This YAML exists as a forward-pointer so consumers searching for the mining-specific NSID find a stub that points them to the canonical record. See RFC 014 in spec-research-suite/docs/lexicons/proposals/014_mining_and_sentence_card.md (§4 — "Reserved NSID").

record.description: Stub. Real implementation lives at tools.spec.srs.card.created#main. This stub is intentionally not extensible and contains no real fields. Clients should emit tools.spec.srs.card.created events with miningSource populated; do NOT emit this record.

seeAlso.description: Pointer to the canonical record and to the RFC.
